reference_solution:
a = input().strip()
b = input().strip()

i = len(a) - 1
j = len(b) - 1
carry = 0
out = []

while i >= 0 or j >= 0 or carry > 0:
    da = int(a[i]) if i >= 0 else 0
    db = int(b[j]) if j >= 0 else 0
    total = da + db + carry
    out.append(str(total % 10))
    carry = total // 10
    i -= 1
    j -= 1

print(''.join(reversed(out)))
